git_errors_config_failed: Commit identity form error when `git config` fails without printing anything. {key} is user.name or user.email.
git_errors_config_failed_output: Commit identity form error when `git config` fails. {key} is user.name or user.email, {output} is git's own words.
git_errors_conflict: Git error sentence: a merge, pull or rebase hit conflicts (kind conflict).
git_errors_details: Action of a git error toast: opens a dialog with git's own output.
git_errors_identity_email: Validation message under the commit identity form when the e-mail has no valid shape.
git_errors_identity_name: Validation message under the commit identity form when the name is empty.
git_errors_local_changes: Git error sentence: the command would overwrite uncommitted work (kind local-changes).
git_errors_locked: Git error sentence: index.lock or another lock file exists (kind locked).
git_errors_no_commits: Git error sentence: the repository has no commit yet (kind no-commits).
git_errors_no_remote: Git error sentence: push or pull with no remote configured (kind no-remote).
git_errors_no_upstream: Git error sentence: the branch has no upstream (kind no-upstream).
git_errors_not_repo: Toast and panel text when a git command ran in a folder that is not a git repository (classifyGitError, kind not-repo).
git_errors_nothing_to_commit: Git error sentence: commit with nothing staged (kind nothing-to-commit).
git_errors_other: Generic git failure sentence for any error without its own message; git's own output is shown as the details.
git_errors_other_line: Git error sentence for an error with no message of its own. {line} is the first line git printed, in git's own words (English); the full output is the details.
git_errors_rejected: Git error sentence: a push was rejected as non-fast-forward (kind rejected).
git_errors_remote_access: Git error sentence: network, address or authentication failure talking to the remote (kind remote-access).
